units: cycles are clk_a1 cycles at 187.5 MHz (period 5.333 ns); MB = 1e6 B

label_taxonomy.measured: read from a frozen artefact (1-frame stage probe log, b6 comp bench, P1 r1 evt)
label_taxonomy.derived: computed from the b11 RTL structure or from arithmetic on measured values
label_taxonomy.assumed: a stated assumption that is not measured; the fitted sub-label below belongs here
label_taxonomy.assumed(fitted): a coefficient obtained by solving the cycle-accounting system on measured anchors; it is an ASSUMPTION about mechanism costs, never a measurement, and the frozen measured/derived/assumed vocabulary has no separate 'fitted' class (r1 mapping requested by OBS-3)
label_taxonomy.not_applicable: the quantity has no meaning for this task

constructive_zero_note: N/L/comp in-sample residuals are 0 BY CONSTRUCTION (three anchors, three unknowns); they are not validation. Validation is the leave-one-out block in out/coregap-model.json (all three folds within 5%).

frozen_boundaries.source: dev-plan section 2 + fpga-design-guide sections 1-5 + P1 r1b report

labels.C1: measured but CHAIN level, not core level

per_symbol_overhead.definition: 5 cycles per match (match costs len+5 for len bytes); a literal costs 1 cycle = the 1 cycle/position baseline

coefficients.name: c_scan_per_position
coefficients.label: derived
coefficients.evidence: a1_deflate_core.v S_SCAN (1446-1509): one emitted symbol start per cycle

coefficients.name: c_match_fixed
coefficients.label: derived
coefficients.evidence: S_SCAN 1 + S_EXT (len-2) + S_MLEN 1 + S_MCHK 1 + S_REPOS 4 = len+5 per match (1511-1612)

coefficients.name: c_stored_per_block_byte
coefficients.label: derived
coefficients.evidence: S_SDATA_R (1727-1742) emits one bm byte per cycle

coefficients.name: r_replay_per_stream_byte
coefficients.label: assumed(fitted)
coefficients.evidence: S_REPLAY_R + S_REPLAY_RD + 2x S_REPLAY_E (1657-1689) = 4 cycles per 2 bytes; out_space backpressure and the last-word tail pull the fitted value below 2.0
coefficients.fitted_from: N probe counters + L probe counters + comp b6 anchor

coefficients.name: c_abort_credit
coefficients.label: assumed(fitted)
coefficients.evidence: a block whose candidate aborts (cand_abort -> S_DECIDE -> stored) stops scanning early, so a full scan (B + 5M) overstates it; the credit is not observable from the 9 counters
coefficients.why_it_exists: with only (r,k) the two-content solve returns k = -2418 cycles/block (unphysical) because the aborted-block count differs strongly by content (N 83 / L 210 / comp 0). Adding c_ab makes all three coefficients positive; the r1 assumptions file labels it assumed(fitted)
coefficients.joint_solve_note: the three coefficients are solved simultaneously from three equations: N: 1,279,097 r + 540 k - 83 c_ab = 2,497,710; L: 1,147,818 r + 540 k - 210 c_ab = 2,107,346; comp: 50,310 r + 32 k = 105,021

superseded.name: aborted_scan_credit = 0.0 (r0 file, label assumed, 'absorbed into k')
superseded.why: superseded by the explicit c_ab term (OBS-3); keeping it as 0 contradicted the model

measured_inputs.N_probe: sim/logs/n-probe.log -> out/stage-probe.json (frame 1 of the P1 frozen raw40_n.hex)
measured_inputs.L_probe: sim/logs/l-probe.log -> out/stage-probe.json (frame 1 of the P1 frozen raw40_l.hex)
measured_inputs.comp_anchor: b6 r0 result-r0.md sections 2/7: 355,261 cycles, 153,600 B in, 50,310 B out, 19,328 matches
measured_inputs.P1_r1: content-verdict-r1.json: S_ss N 7,475,240 / L 6,986,952; frame-1 core_interval N 7,476,245 / L 6,979,811
measured_inputs.b11_routed: WNS +0.015 ns @187.5 MHz (single core, frozen input)
measured_inputs.C1_chain: P4 R1 S_ss 4,677,970 cycles, payload 81,707 B/frame (CHAIN level, excluded from the fit)

assumptions.text: the b11 FSM cycle costs above are content-independent, so one (r,k,c_ab) set transfers between N, L and comp
assumptions.label: assumed(fitted)
assumptions.test: L and N are each held out of the fit and predicted; comp is predicted with k >= 0

assumptions.text: C1's P4 S_ss is a chain interval, not a core interval
assumptions.label: derived
assumptions.test: the physical-coefficient core bound is 2,905,862..3,042,041 = 63.19% of the chain, so the chain contains capture/feed/export work

assumptions.text: scheme matrix resource deltas are engineering estimates, not synthesis results
assumptions.label: assumed

assumptions.text: the 224.3 MHz closure arithmetic assumes the current cycles/frame are unchanged
assumptions.label: derived

assumptions.text: rows B/C carry an assumed 2% scan credit (-0.02*scan) that is NOT a matcher result; the matcher itself is not probe-validated
assumptions.label: assumed
assumptions.test: not used for any closure claim; both rows stay 'no'

not_measured: any modified-core cycle count (no RTL change is allowed in this task)
